description: Fenagy H-600 CO₂ is a 600 kW air source heat pump, using R744 refrigerant.
notes: Danish-built. CO₂ transcritical. 3-4 compressors (VSD). Patented ejector technology. Available as air-to-water or water-to-water. COP 3.0-3.5 at nominal 40/70°C return/supply, 5°C/85%RH. Evaporator noise: 40 dB(A) at 10m. Walk-in enclosure option.

description: Fenagy H-2600 CO₂ is a 3000 kW air source heat pump, using R744 refrigerant.

description: Fenagy HCI-1000 R600a is a 1000 kW water source heat pump, providing heating and cooling, using R600a refrigerant.
notes: Danish-built. R600a isobutane — high-temperature natural refrigerant. Screw compressor, 3-step (50/75/100%) or VSD. Supply up to 95°C. COP range 3.0-6.0 depending on conditions. Water-to-water only. Ventilated reach-in cabinet for machine room. 690V supply. Heat pump, chiller, or combined operation. Up to 3 units in series (3 MW).

description: Fenagy HCI-2000 R600a is a 2000 kW water source heat pump, providing heating and cooling, using R600a refrigerant.

description: Fenagy HCP-1000 R290 is a 1000 kW water source heat pump, providing heating and cooling, using R290 refrigerant.

description: York YMAE is a 132 kW air source heat pump, providing heating and cooling, using R454B refrigerant.
notes: Four-pipe modular air-to-water heat pump chiller from the YORK YMAE range (35-140 ton nominal sizes; two-pipe YMAE0035PJP variant also available). Nominal size 35 tons; approx. cooling capacity 123.1 kW. DC inverter EVI scroll compressor(s) (2 compressor(s)/circuits), R454B refrigerant, approx. 23.0 kg total charge (11.52 kg/circuit). EC axial fans, brazed-plate heat exchangers, OptiView LT controller (Verasys-compatible; BACnet MS/TP, Modbus RTU or N2). Four-pipe version supports full-capacity heating-only, cooling-only, and simultaneous heating-and-cooling (heat recovery) with independent hot/chilled water temperature control; COPshc exceeds 8 in simultaneous mode. Rated IPLV up to 20.01 BTU/W, EER 10.2 BTU/W (~2.99 W/W), displacement power factor up to 0.93. Modular design permits forklift loading and incremental capacity expansion; other modules keep operating if one needs maintenance. Optional Ultra Quiet Kit reduces sound power by up to 5 dBA. Heating rating: A47°F/43°F db/wb, 105°F LWT (COPH 3.55).

description: Intergas Xtend Monobloc is a 5 kW hybrid air source heat pump (monobloc, water heated outside the property) designed to work alongside an Intergas ErP boiler, using R32 refrigerant.
notes: Hybrid heat pump designed to work alongside an Intergas ErP combi or system boiler (boiler doesn't need to be Intergas-made, provided it's OpenTherm/on-off compatible). Output range 1.8-5.04 kW, nominal 5.04 kW / COP 4.68 at A7/W35, space heating energy class A++. Refrigerant R32, charge 0.85 kg. Heat pump operating range -15°C to 25°C ambient; max system water (flow) temperature 55°C. Sound power: indoor control unit 32 dB(A), heat pump (outdoor) unit 49 dB(A); sound pressure at 1/2/3/5m: 48/42/38.5/34 dB(A). Monobloc: water is heated outside the property; minimum 3m, maximum 10m pipe run between heat pump and indoor unit; no F-Gas certification needed for installation as the refrigerant circuit is factory-sealed. Indoor control unit: 557 x 164 x 275mm, 5 kg. Comes with Comfort Touch OpenTherm room thermostat and Intergas Gateway. Compatible with, and can be retrofitted to, the following Intergas boiler ranges: Rapid, Rapid Plus, HRE, Eco RF, Xclusive and Xtreme (there are indoor-unit/boiler variants for each of these — warranty terms vary by range and whether new-build or retrofit; see manufacturer literature for details).

description: Intergas Xtend Split is a 5 kW hybrid air source heat pump (split system, water heated inside the property) designed to work alongside an Intergas ErP boiler, using R32 refrigerant.
notes: Hybrid heat pump designed to work alongside an Intergas ErP combi or system boiler (boiler doesn't need to be Intergas-made, provided it's OpenTherm/on-off compatible). Heat pump operating range -15°C to 25°C ambient; max system water (flow) temperature 55°C. Sound power: indoor control unit 32 dB(A), heat pump (outdoor) unit 49 dB(A); sound pressure at 1/2/3/5m: 48/42/38.5/34 dB(A). Split system: water is heated inside the property; minimum 3m, maximum 25m pipe run between heat pump and indoor unit (pre-filled for the first 6m; add 25g of R32 per additional metre beyond 6m); F-Gas certification is required for installation as the refrigerant circuit is handled on site. Compatible with, and can be retrofitted to, the following Intergas boiler ranges: Rapid, Rapid Plus, HRE, Eco RF, Xclusive and Xtreme (there are indoor-unit/boiler variants for each of these — warranty terms vary by range and whether new-build or retrofit; see manufacturer literature for details).

notes: Monobloc air source heat pump, R290 refrigerant. Operating ranges: heating ambient -25 to 35°C (water outlet 20–75°C); cooling ambient 15 to 45°C (water outlet 5–25°C); DHW ambient 25 to 45°C (water outlet 20–65°C). Max power input 3.5 kW, max current 15 A, 230V/1P/50Hz. Operating pressure 0.8 MPa (low) / 3.9 MPa (high), max allowable 3.2 MPa. Note: the output range, COP figures, refrigerant and net weight for this unit are numerically identical to the Intergas Xceed monobloc of the same capacity class already in this database, suggesting a shared OEM hardware platform sold under both brand names — Wondrwall's differentiation is primarily its smart-controls/HEMS layer rather than the heat pump hardware itself.

description: Rhoss Y-Flow THHEY 115 is a 17.4 kW water source heat pump, using R410A refrigerant.
notes: Compact packaged water-cooled reversible heat pump (Plug&Play, upward hydraulic connections) for applications with well water, water mains or geothermal probes, scroll hermetic compressor, R410A refrigerant. Rated (evaporator 10→7°C / condenser 40→45°C): 17.4 kW heating, COP 4.4 (absorbed 3.95 kW). Cooling (chilled water 12→7°C / condenser water 30→35°C): 13.9 kW, EER 3.81. Seasonal heating (EN14825, Average climate, low-temp 35°C application): Pdesignh 23 kW, SCOP 6.1, energy class A+++. On geothermal probes (evaporator water 0/−3°C, 30% glycol) the unit is also rated for lower-temperature hot water (30/35°C) duty at reduced COP. A cooling-only variant of this size (TCHEY) is also offered but is not a heat pump.
